name: Sal
source:
A satyr who cooks for a living. His life isn't bad, but it's quite mundane. He's got some trust issues and there's an aura around him of grouchiness. But in reality, he's quite sweet.

[From [url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/solanaceae-another-time]itch.io[/url]]
